name: Ancient City of Polonnaruwa
description: Polonnaruwa, in north-central Sri Lanka, was the island's capital after Anuradhapura fell in 993. Visitors wander among brick ruins of palaces and temples, including Hindu shrines left by the Chola rulers. The site also holds the remains of the 12th-century garden-city that King Parakramabahu I built, once among the island's grandest royal centres.
